correctness.rationale: Exact central-arc fibers exhaust all directed paths; an explicit monotone fiberwise acyclic matching leaves one vertex, one (n−1)-cell and 2n n-cells. The 2n independent integral join cycles have unique non-coface top facets, forcing zero cellular top boundary. Degree-zero maps to S^(n−1) are nullhomotopic for n≥2, proving the integral wedge. Independently executed finite acyclicity and mod-two boundary checks agree in the stated ranges.

value.rationale: Classifies a natural all-n infinite family of strongly interacting directed-cycle bouquets, producing an integral mixed-degree sphere wedge with explicit generators. Neither single-polygon homology nor acyclic-graph machinery settles the common-hub attaching maps, and the result offers a structural test case for homotopy classification of multipath complexes beyond cycle-free classes.
